title: Fiber
notes: Fiber's router, view engine (html/template) and JSON helper on its own fasthttp server. No prefork, no middleware.
details: Fiber's router, its view engine (github.com/gofiber/template/html and c.Render, which is Go's html/template and does the escaping) and c.JSON, on Fiber's own server (fasthttp, not net/http) through app.Listener on the harness's listener, with no prefork (the default) and no middleware (a new Fiber application has none). The startup message is left on, as by default. The template engine is at v3.0.8, the last release that builds with the Go toolchain pinned here (v3.0.9 needs Go 1.26). One process on the default Go scheduler (GOMAXPROCS is every core), built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed once when the server starts. No request logging.
